ofelia.quote: We waited three years for a roof that could hold up to the rain. They came, took measurements, returned with materials, and stayed until it was finished. They didn't give us charity — they gave us a home.
ofelia.name: Ofelia Tlaltzin

javier.quote: I started carrying sacks one Saturday. Today I coordinate the Tehuacán food-parcel route. The foundation doesn't recruit you — it invites you to come back.
javier.name: Javier Olmedo

carmen.quote: I've been giving since 2019. Every month I receive a report on how my contribution was spent, with photos and an invoice. It's the only organization I question less and give more to.
carmen.name: Eng. Carmen Espinosa

mario.quote: They came without cameras, without speeches. They asked permission, listened to my mother, and worked six Saturdays in a row. When they left, they handed us a key and a certificate of completion.
mario.name: Mario Hernández
